title: Comparative Analysis of bPACy and WT Organisms under Blue Light Illumination
summary: This cluster focuses on the comparative analysis of bPACy and wild-type (WT) organisms under blue light illumination. The organisms were exposed to blue light and darkness, and their proteomes and metabolomes were analyzed. The bPACy organism had lower adenylate energy charge and lower abundance of Pde1 compared to WT. The blue light illumination was characterized by specific conditions, including intensity, temperature, and wavelength. The study also involved the use of various methods and tools, including PKA, Pde1, and Cyr1, which were regulated by cAMP. The results of this analysis are presented in the Supplemental Material.
